title: V6.2 Stage 1: Per-Family Evidence Direction Extraction
description: Stage 1 runs ONCE per case, over ALL case_available_evidence_ids at once (not once per family -- see README for the latency rationale). It performs ONLY extraction + directional classification. It must NOT form a thesis, must NOT decide REJECT/WATCH/CANDIDATE/HIGH_CONVICTION, and must NOT propose an entry or failure-exit price. Keeping this stage single-purpose is the core fix for task overload.

evidence_id.description: Must be one of the case_available_evidence_ids supplied for this case. Stage-2/3 validators reject any id not in that set.

exact_observations.description: Each item must directly restate a number or short verbatim phrase actually present in the supplied packet for this evidence family (e.g. 'PE = 215.37', 'revenue YoY = -19.84%', 'MOPS title: 董事會通過第三季合併財務報告'). Never a paraphrase that adds an interpretation. No invented figures. This is the field a downstream critic and a human reviewer both check claims against.

direction.description: SUPPORTIVE/CONTRADICTORY are relative to a >=10% upside opportunity. MIXED means the family itself contains both supportive and contradictory signals (e.g. institutional flow negative last session but positive 20-day mean). NOT_INTERPRETABLE means the raw data cannot be assigned a direction without further context Stage 1 does not have (e.g. a single macro data point with no trend).

timeliness.description: CURRENT: this evidence reflects a recent/current state. STALE: the evidence is old relative to the decision date (e.g. a MOPS filing more than ~30 trading days old). Routine or periodic content is not stale merely because it is routine; express low novelty through relevance/limitations. UNKNOWN_AGE: no timestamp/age metadata was supplied.

relevance_to_hypothesis_space.description: How directly this family speaks to a >=10% opportunity thesis, independent of its direction.

limitations.description: Concrete caveats on this family's evidentiary value, stated explicitly rather than silently assumed away. Common required limitations (Stage 1 MUST state these when applicable; deterministic validators check for their presence, see D.4/D.5/D.6 rules): 'no historical or peer valuation benchmark supplied -- cheap/expensive cannot be asserted'; 'single-period revenue change -- does not by itself establish a sustained trend'; 'routine/periodic filing -- not evidence of a new catalyst'; 'mixed direction across sub-signals -- cannot be summarized as uniformly positive or negative'.

benchmark_available.description: True only if the packet supplies an explicit historical or peer comparison point for this family (e.g. a historical PE band, a peer PE). Stage 2/Critic use this to deterministically block any 'cheap'/'expensive'/'undervalued' claim when false.
